blocks.text: Fourteen days to discover the best of Guatemala: colonial Antigua and Pacaya Volcano, Lake Atitlán and Chichicastenango, the cloud forest of the quetzal and the turquoise pools of Semuc Champey, the Candelaria Caves and Tikal, the Caribbean world of Río Dulce and Livingston, and the Maya city of Copán in Honduras.
